interpretation.denominator: This is a complete grouping of the active DataSF nonprofit-prime-contract snapshot by Unicode-, whitespace-, and case-normalized published contractor name. It is not a census of Bay Area nonprofits, and one legal entity may appear under more than one source name.
interpretation.identity: Rows are source-name identities, not EIN-verified organizations. Exact aliases connect four rows to an existing MFI scorecard; fuzzy merges are prohibited.
interpretation.scale: Contract authority, payments, and remaining authority are public-accounting context. They do not measure nonprofit revenue, capacity, philanthropic need, effectiveness, or room for more funding.
interpretation.cause: Outcome labels (Housing stability, Unsheltered days avoided, Overdose deaths averted, Mental-health stabilization, Food security, Educational attainment, Violence reduction, Economic mobility) come from MFI's contract-text rules. Unclassified means the accepted rules found no match, not that the work lacks impact.
interpretation.recommendation: Every row is a discovery lead. Only six organizations have initial scorecards, none has a published, independently reviewed marginal funding gap, and this universe makes no recommendation.
